show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/bqakqy
show.description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Vijay, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Sanjana due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Vijay secretly uses his powers to protect Sanjana, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.
